title: Quirk Skill Runtime Manifest
description: Runtime manifest for one bundle skill, derived mechanically from its SKILL.md frontmatter by scripts/build-runtime-manifests.mjs.

skill.description: Bundle skill identity as <domain>/<skill> (for example delivery/review-pr).

generatedFrom.description: Source the manifest was derived from; frontmatter for generated manifests.

frontmatterHash.description: sha256 of the JSON-stringified frontmatter with sorted keys; the validator compares it to detect drift.

role.description: Declared role of the skill inside the routing graph.

router.description: Routing signals; optional and reserved for a later phase.

positive.description: Queries or phrases that should route to this skill.

negative.description: Queries or phrases that must not route to this skill.

requiredSignals.description: Signals a query must carry before this skill is eligible.

execution.description: How a runtime executes the skill.

defaultAgent.description: Default sub-agent kind; explore for read-only tier-1 skills, general otherwise.

isolation.description: Filesystem isolation required while the skill runs.

maxTurns.description: Turn budget; the frontmatter maxIterations or the default of 6.

modelTier.description: Model tier the manifest routes to; the frontmatter code tier normalizes to reasoning.

tools.description: Conservative tool policy derived from the frontmatter.

allow.description: Tool names the skill may use.

deny.description: Tool names the skill must not use; non-empty only for high-risk skills.

guardrails.description: Safety envelope copied from the frontmatter.

sideEffects.description: Declared side effects; empty when the frontmatter declares none.

approvalRequired.description: Whether the skill must obtain approval before acting.

risk.description: Declared risk class; low when the frontmatter declares none.

trustTier.description: Declared trust tier 1-4; 1 when the frontmatter declares none.

commands.description: Commands that verify the skill; the repo gate for delivery, skill-dev, and platform domain skills.

artifactSchema.description: Repository-relative artifact schema path when .agents/skills/platform/schemas/<artifactType>-schema.json exists; null otherwise.

traceEvents.description: Trace event names the skill emits.
